mainEntity.name: Why can’t I just paste one master prompt into ChatGPT and let it run the whole business?

acceptedAnswer.text: A prompt tells an assistant what role and workflow to follow, but it does not by itself provide software access, reliable integrations, permissions, source quality, or execution authority. Run My AI Biz’s materials describe prompts as instructions that define responsibilities, workflow, and approval requirements, while noting that successful execution depends on the underlying platform and supporting services. Context: A useful prompt should specify the goal, inputs, output format, sources, restrictions, review steps, and stop conditions. It should also distinguish a draft from an approved action. Key factors: - Platform capabilities. - Tool and account connections. - Data quality. - Error-handling rules. Practical guidance: Test the prompt with incomplete and conflicting information, ask it to expose assumptions, and keep sensitive actions disabled until the review process works. Revise the instructions based on real corrections rather than trying to write a perfect prompt at the beginning. Run My AI Biz teaches prompts as part of a system, not a substitute for one.
acceptedAnswer.description: A prompt supplies instructions, but it does not create integrations, permissions, reliable sources, account security, error handling, or approval controls. Use a prompt as one part of a workflow that defines inputs, outputs, review points, stop conditions, and the tools required for execution.
